name: charter-conformance-ts
description: The conformance API in TypeScript on Cloudflare Workers: every Fern feature charter uses, in one small API, from an oRPC contract (src/contract.ts). The Worker serves that API (/api/mock) and is also the harness that runs the generated TypeScript SDK against it inside workerd (/api/sdk-test). npm run check is every local check (no Cloudflare account); npm run dev runs it locally; npx charter-ts lists every step.
